headline: International Flavors Stock Soars; The Sweet Smell Of Success
summary:

On Wednesday, the Relative Strength Rating for International Flavors stock jumped 10 points to 80, breaking above a key threshold. The 80 RS Rating means International Flavors stock has outperformed 80% of all stocks, regardless of industry group, on price performance.
